international.title: European-made pesticides named in 1,605 poisoning reports in Brazil last year
international.summary: About a third of cases involved chemicals banned for use on EU farms, according to investigation by Unearthed and Public Eye Pesticides sold by European chemical companies were named in more than 1,600 poisoning reports in Brazil last year, an investigation has found. About a third of the cases involved chemicals banned from use on farms in the EU because of the risks they pose to people and the environment. But European companies are not banned from manufacturing these chemicals, as long as they export them overseas to countries where they are legally allowed to be used. Continue reading...
